name: – Recital K – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom and rule of law in the Czech Republic: threats to the independence of public broadcasters
part_text: K. whereas international and Czech non-governmental organisations, including Reporters Without Borders, the International Press Institute, the European Federation of Journalists, Freedom House and Transparency International Czech Republic, as well as the Media Pluralism Monitor, have warned that politically concentrated media ownership threatens pluralism and that hostile rhetoric by senior politicians intimidates journalists; whereas, on 5 October 2026, around 40 Czech editors-in-chief, including representatives of Czech Television and Czech Radio, urged officials to reject violence, uphold civil discourse and guarantee equal access to public information; whereas Czechia fell from 23rd in 2017 to 40th in 2019–2021 in the World Press Freedom Index, and the 2026 Media Pluralism Monitor rates overall risk at 51 % and market plurality risk at 74 %; whereas in 2026, after one year of a government led by Prime Minister Andrej Babiš, the Czech Republic ranked 11th out of 180 countries;
